paragraphs: An E. coli O145 outbreak linked to frozen blueberries is now over [1]. The outbreak sickened 17 people across 2 states, with 6 hospitalizations and no deaths [1].

Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. of Brooklyn, New York, is recalling Starfish Seafood Trio – Cold Smoked Salmon, Halibut, and Trout (8 oz packages) because the product has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes [4]. Gardeners Basics of Spanish Fork, Utah, is recalling one-pound bags of Waltham 29 Broccoli Sprouting Seeds because they may be contaminated with Salmonella [5]. Eden Brothers LLC is recalling Calabrese Broccoli Seeds in 1-ounce and 1-pound sizes (lots 1022067 and 1022068) due to possible Salmonella contamination [6]. Oliva LLC of Bethlehem, Connecticut, is recalling approximately 250 units of Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus because it may contain undeclared sesame [3].
The USDA issued a public health alert for 140-gram cans of Grace Ready to Eat Chicken Vienna Sausages illegally imported from Jamaica, found in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, and Texas [2].
